Taj Mahal Practical Visitor Guide 2026

Everything you need to know before visiting Agra: official ASI ticket prices, Friday closure rules, luggage cloaks, prohibited gear, and avoiding touts.

1. Friday Closure Rule (Strictly Enforced)

The Taj Mahal is CLOSED EVERY FRIDAY for general visitors. However, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri, Itimad-ud-Daulah, and Mehtab Bagh remain open. Plan your trip so your Taj visit falls on Saturday through Thursday.

2. Official Ticket Rates (2026 ASI Rates)

  • Foreign Tourists: ₹1,100 standard entry + ₹200 for main dome access (Total ₹1,300 / approx $16 USD). Includes shoe covers and a 500ml water bottle.
  • SAARC & BIMSTEC Visitors: ₹540 + ₹200 dome access (Total ₹740).
  • Indian Citizens: ₹50 + ₹200 dome access (Total ₹250).
  • Children under 15 years: Free entry (Indian and International).

3. Prohibited Items Inside Monument

Security is administered by the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF). Prohibited: tripods, camera gimbals/stabilizers, drones, electronic chargers/power banks, knives, lighters, cigarettes, and chewing gum. Safe lockers are available at East and West gates.
